name: @grudanov-nikolay/agenttrace-opencode-plugin
description: agenttrace observability plugin for OpenCode. Fork of @raindrop-ai/opencode-plugin (https://github.com/raindrop-ai/opencode-plugin) — full upstream credits and the list of carried fixes live in README.md. Renamed from @grudanov-nikolay/opencode-workshop-plugin@0.0.1 → @grudanov-nikolay/agenttrace-opencode-plugin@0.1.0 on 2026-09-17 (F-024). Carries: MCP tool.execute.after crash workaround (upstream issue anomalyco/opencode#21149), AGENTTRACE_LOCAL_WORKSHOP_URL non-local fallback, subagent_name recovery on nested sub-agents (task span + child LLM span + Subagent root), result.error propagation into span status=ERROR, and Workshop sidepanel bootstrap when AGENTTRACE_SIDEPANEL_ACTIVE=1.
author: Nikolai Grudanov <nikolay-grudanov@users.noreply.github.com>
